# grouper_stem (Resource)

Manages a Grouper folder (stem). The parent stem must already exist; this resource does not create missing parents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_stem" "cloud" {
  name         = "example:apps:myteam:example"
  display_name = "Example"
  description  = "Example folder managed by Terraform"
}

# Import by UUID:
#   terraform import grouper_stem.cloud 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
#
# Import by full name:
#   terraform import grouper_stem.cloud name:example:apps:myteam:example
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full colon-delimited system name of the stem, e.g. `example:apps:myteam`. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the stem.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display label for this stem component (Grouper `displayExtension`). Defaults to the last path component if unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grouper UUID of the stem. Used as the stable Terraform identifier.
- `parent_stem_name` (String) Full name of the parent stem, derived from `name`. Empty for a top-level stem.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by Grouper UUID:
terraform import grouper_stem.example 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# Import by full stem name (resolved to its UUID):
terraform import grouper_stem.example name:example:apps:myteam:example
```
